fields.default: Three clips that changed our roadmap this quarter

fields.label: Article
fields.default:
Every research team we meet has the same drawer. It is full of recordings nobody rewatches, transcripts nobody searches and slide decks that summarise a summary. The insight was real when someone heard it. By the time it reached the roadmap, it had been flattened into a bullet point.

Keep the customer’s own words

The fix is not more reports. It is shorter distances. When a product manager can hear the hesitation in a customer’s voice, the argument is over before it starts. That is why we clip, tag and share the moment itself, not our description of it.

  • Clip the 20 seconds that matter, straight from the transcript
  • Tag it once, so it shows up wherever the theme comes up again
  • Share a link that plays in any browser, no account needed

Make it a habit, not a project

Teams that get the most out of research do not run bigger studies. They run smaller ones, every week, and they put the highlights where decisions already happen: the planning doc, the sprint review, the Monday channel. Research stops being a deliverable and becomes part of how the team thinks.

Start with one conversation this week. Tag three moments. Send them to the person who most needs to hear them. That is the whole method.
